description.value: Backcountry Brewing is a craft brewery, tasting room, and kitchen that opened in 2017 in Squamish, winning BC Beer Awards 'Rookie of the Year' that same year. The 70s ski cabin-inspired taproom offers over 50 limited-edition beers annually alongside a full food menu of pizzas, salads, and snacks developed by a Red Seal chef. A shipping container patio, a 38-seat Barrel Lounge for groups, and covered bike parking out front make it a natural stop on any Sea-to-Sky corridor ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Backcountry Brewing at #405-1201 Commercial Way, Squamish BC, with phone 604-567-2739 matching OSM. The FAQs page explicitly states 'covered bike parking in front of the taproom' (where dogs may be tied up), confirming that amenity; the FAQs also confirm vegan/dairy-free food options and takeout beer-to-go in cans. The OSM name 'Backcountry Growlers & Store' is inconsistent with the business's own branding ('Backcountry Brewing') and is further undermined by the FAQ explicitly stating they no longer offer growler fills.
concerns: OSM name 'Backcountry Growlers & Store' does not match the business's own branding 'Backcountry Brewing' used consistently across the website.
Business explicitly states in FAQ they no longer offer growler fills, making the OSM name doubly outdated and potentially misleading.
OSM record has no address field populated; address sourced from website only (#405-1201 Commercial Way, Squamish BC V8B 0V1).
